data.one_liner: Flutter text widget that automatically converts inlined URLs into clickable links.
data.what_it_does: The LinkText widget parses strings containing inlined URLs and renders them as clickable links. It allows custom styling and supports optional tap event handlers and URL parameter trimming.
use_when: You need to display text containing URLs that users can tap to open.
You want a drop-in replacement for the standard Text widget with automatic linkification.
avoid_when: You need complex rich text formatting with multiple custom gesture recognizers other than links.
strengths: Zero setup required out of the box.
Allows custom styling and overriding default link tap behavior.
Supports trimming link parameters for better readability.
weaknesses: Limited to linkifying URLs rather than general rich text parsing (mentions, hashtags, etc.).
